tools.description: List local tools with their exact server, name, description, and effective Auto mode enabled state. Use this list to find a tool, then enable it before calling it. Manual settings are separate.
tools.name: get_tool_list

tools.description: Disable one Auto mode tool by its exact server and name. State is shared by all users until reboot and survives Auto OFF/ON within the same boot. Manual UCI tool settings are unchanged. Tool Search control tools cannot be changed through this API.
tools.name: set_tool_disabled

tools.description: Enable one Auto mode tool by its exact server and name so it can be called next. State is shared by all users until reboot and survives Auto OFF/ON within the same boot. Manual UCI tool settings are unchanged. Tool Search control tools are managed automatically.
tools.name: set_tool_enabled
